context: Research-findings report: Ren presents a survey to Hiroshi-boss.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: formal report; survey/research vocabulary in natural home.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 先月、利用者の調査を行いました。
lines.en: Last month we conducted a user survey.
lines.style: measured young presenter voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: どのように、調査を行ったのかね?
lines.en: How did you conduct the survey?
lines.style: attentive boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: アンケートを、全国で行いました。
lines.style: precise young presenter voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 何か、明らかになったことは?
lines.style: engaged boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 一部の利用者の不満が、明らかになりました。
lines.style: careful young presenter voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: その認識は、社内にもあったのかね?
lines.en: Did that awareness exist internally too?
lines.style: thoughtful boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 一部の社員は、認識していました。
lines.en: Some employees were aware of it.
lines.style: measured young presenter voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 次は、どんな対策を行うのかね?
lines.en: What measures will we take next?
lines.style: decisive boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 改善を、段階的に行う予定です。
lines.en: We plan to make improvements in stages.
lines.style: confident young presenter voice, soft warm professional resolved throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 認識を、社内で共有しておこう。
lines.en: Let's share this awareness across the company.
lines.style: measured boss voice, soft warm decisive closing throughout
